Kerala private bus operators consider strike over free travel scheme

Private bus operators in Kerala are contemplating a strike on July 6, protesting the state government's free bus travel scheme. The government plans to map overlapping routes of state-run KSRTC buses and private buses to address concerns. The strike call highlights tensions between public and private transport services in the state.
